service_at_issue: Hospital-to-hospital air ambulance (A0435 mileage, 203 miles) from Beaver, Oklahoma to Wichita, Kansas
outcome_note: The 70 miles beyond the nearest appropriate facility were not covered, though the beneficiary rather than the provider was held liable for them.
facts: The appellant initially submitted a claim for 203 units (miles) of procedure code A0435-II. Exh. 2, at 2.
